pages.title: Enemy Uchigatana
pages.text: Uchigatana-type monsters. They possess average attack speed, damage, and spawn frequency.

pages.name: Enemy Uchigatana
pages.text: The basic uchigatana unit of the Retrograde Army. Similar in size to the player, with average attack speed.

pages.name: Enemy Specialized Uchigatana
pages.text: A specialized enemy uchigatana with slightly increased attack power and movement speed, posing a significantly greater threat.

pages.name: Enemy Kiwame Uchigatana
pages.text: The Kiwame form of enemy uchigatana, possessing higher attack speed and damage. A relatively high threat.
